sections.howItWorksStep1Body: Use structured filters or plain language — whichever is easier.
sections.howItWorksStep2Body: See caregivers ranked by fit, with a clear explanation for each.
sections.howItWorksStep3Body: Create a free account to contact or hire a caregiver.
sections.verifiedBody: Caregivers with a verified qualification have had their credentials checked against the issuing institution. We show this clearly so you can weigh it in your decision.
sections.safetyBody: Search without an account or sharing any personal details. When you ask for a caregiver, our team calls you and arranges the introduction. Your phone number, address and your family's health information are never shown on the site, and are only shared with a caregiver once you agree.
sections.multilingualBody: This site works in English, Sinhala, and Tamil.
sections.ctaTitle: Ready to find the right caregiver?
sections.ctaBody: Start with a search above — no account needed.

footer.disclaimer: Search results are ranked automatically based on the filters you provide. They are not a recommendation or guarantee of fit.

international.heroTitle: Hire trusted caregivers from Sri Lanka
international.heroBody: Agencies, care homes, hospitals and families overseas: tell us who you need and we will put forward verified caregivers trained in English and caregiving. You pay a placement fee only when a caregiver starts work with you.

steps.title: From enquiry to a caregiver at work
steps.step1Body: The roles, the care setting, the languages and when you need someone to start.
steps.step2Body: Our team matches verified caregivers who want to work in your country and checks they are ready.
steps.step3Body: We introduce the caregivers and arrange interviews. You choose who to hire.
steps.step4Body: Once a caregiver starts, you pay the agreed placement fee. Nothing before that.

why.title: Why hire through us
why.verifiedBody: Identity, police clearance and qualifications are checked by our team before a caregiver is marked Verified.
why.trainedBody: Caregivers can take our English and basic caregiving courses. Completed training is shown on their profile.
why.mediatedBody: We handle every introduction and stay in touch with you and the caregiver through the process.
why.ethicalBody: Caregivers are never charged a placement fee. The employer pays it, and only when a caregiver starts work.

talent.title: Caregivers ready to work abroad
talent.body: Caregivers who chose to share their profile with employers. Contact details are never shown - ask about anyone here and our team will introduce you.
talent.empty: No shared profiles match yet. Send us an enquiry and our team will find caregivers for you.

form.title: Tell us what you need
form.body: We reply by email, usually within two working days. No commitment and no fee until a caregiver starts work.
form.messagePlaceholder: Duties, working hours, accommodation, salary range...

form.sentTitle: Thank you - we have your enquiry
form.sentBody: Your reference is {reference}. We have emailed you a copy, and our team will be in touch soon.
form.feeNote: Placement fee only when a caregiver starts work.

faq.title: Questions employers ask
faq.feeA: Sending an enquiry, meeting candidates and interviewing are free. You pay a placement fee, agreed with you in advance, only when a caregiver you hire starts work.
faq.workerFeesA: No. Caregivers are never charged a placement fee by us. If anyone asks a caregiver for money in our name, please tell us.
faq.visasA: The employer offers the contract and arranges the visa under the rules of their country. We will talk the process through with you and help the caregiver prepare their documents.
faq.contactQ: Can I contact a caregiver directly?
faq.contactA: Not through this site. To protect caregivers, contact details are never shown. Our team introduces you and arranges interviews.
faq.languagesQ: What languages do the caregivers speak?
faq.languagesA: Each profile lists the caregiver's languages and their level. Many have taken our English course. Tell us what you need and we will match on it.

workAbroad.heroBody: Improve your English and caregiving skills with our training, then share your profile with employers overseas. Our team makes every introduction - and you never pay us a placement fee.

benefits.trainBody: English and basic caregiving courses. Completed courses show on your profile.
benefits.shareBody: Share a profile with your first name and photo only if you want to. Pause it or delete it any time.
benefits.connectBody: Employers never get your phone number or address. Our team contacts you about suitable jobs.
benefits.noFeesBody: Employers pay the placement fee. If anyone asks you for money in our name, tell us.

training.empty: No courses are open right now. Please check again soon.

steps.title: How it works
steps.step1Body: Create your profile and upload your documents so our team can verify you.
steps.step2Title: Tell us where you want to work
steps.step2Body: In your Work abroad section, choose the countries you are interested in and when you could start.
steps.step3Body: Join our English and caregiving courses. We record each course you complete.
steps.step4Body: When you are ready, share your profile with employers. Our team reviews it first, then contacts you when an employer is interested.

privacy.title: What employers see
privacy.body: Only what you choose to share: your first name, a photo, a short introduction, and the skills, languages and training our team has checked. Never your surname, phone number, address, NIC or passport number.

vacancies.body: Browse caregiving vacancies overseas that our team has checked, and apply from your account.
